translations.idiomatic: In Yongming 7, Liu Yuanbao of Qixing, repairing the commandery seat, found a million coins in the moat, huge in size; he offered them to the court as a portent, and Emperor Shizu graded gifts to ministers and all below.

sentences.zh: 十年，齊安郡民王攝掘地得四文大錢一萬二千七百十枚，品製如一。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the commoner Wang She of Qi'an commandery dug the ground and obtained 12,710 large four-wen coins, uniform in type and manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Wang She of Qi'an commandery dug up 12,710 large four-wen coins, all alike in type and minting.

sentences.zh: 建元元年，郢州監利縣天井湖水色忽澄清，出綿，百姓採以爲纊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan, at Tianjingshu in Jianli county, Yingzhou, the lake water suddenly cleared; cotton floss emerged, and the common people gathered it to make wadding.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyuan 1, at Tianjingshu in Jianli county, Yingzhou, the lake water suddenly cleared and cotton floss rose to the surface; commoners gathered it for wadding.

sentences.zh: 永明二年，護軍府門外桑樹一株，竝有蠶絲綿被枝莖。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongming, outside the Protector-General's mansion gate a mulberry tree bore silk cocoons and floss along its branches and stems.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongming 2, a mulberry outside the Protector-General's gate bore cocoons and floss along branch and stem alike.

sentences.zh: 史臣案：漢光武時有野蠶成蠒，百姓得以成衣服。

translations.literal: The historiographer notes: In the time of Emperor Guangwu of Han, wild silkworms formed cocoons, and the common people were able to make clothing.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer notes: Under Emperor Guangwu of Han, wild silkworms spun cocoons and commoners could clothe themselves.

sentences.zh: 今則浮波幕樹，其亦此之類乎？

translations.literal: Now floss floats on waves and mulberry trees are curtained with silk—is this not of the same kind?
translations.idiomatic: Now floss rides the waves and mulberry trees wear silk like curtains—is this not the same kind of thing?

sentences.zh: 永明八年，始興郡昌樂村獲白鳩一頭。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongming, Changle village in Shixing commandery obtained a white turtledove.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongming 8, Changle village in Shixing commandery obtained a white turtledove.

sentences.zh: 二年，彭澤縣獲白雉一頭。

translations.literal: In the second year, Pengze county obtained a white pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Pengze county obtained a white pheasant.

sentences.zh: 七年，鬱林獲白雉一頭。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yulin obtained a white pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Yulin obtained a white pheasant.

sentences.zh: 十年，青州洍液戍獲白雉一頭。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Zhiye garrison in Qingzhou obtained a white pheasant.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Zhiye garrison in Qingzhou obtained a white pheasant.

sentences.zh: 五年，望蔡縣獲白鹿一頭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Wangcai county obtained a white deer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Wangcai county obtained a white deer.

sentences.zh: 九年，臨湘獲白鹿一頭。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Linxiang obtained a white deer.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Linxiang obtained a white deer.

sentences.zh: 六年，蒲濤縣亮野村獲白麞一頭。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Liangye village in Putao county obtained a white elk.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Liangye village in Putao county obtained a white elk.

sentences.zh: 七年，荊州獲白麞一頭。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Jingzhou obtained a white elk.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Jingzhou obtained a white elk.

sentences.zh: 八年，餘干縣獲白麞一頭。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Yugan county obtained a white elk.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, Yugan county obtained a white elk.

sentences.zh: 九年，義陽安昌縣獲白麞一頭。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Anchang county in Yiyang obtained a white elk.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Anchang county in Yiyang obtained a white elk.

sentences.zh: 十年，司州清激戍獲白麞一頭。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Qingji garrison in Sizhou obtained a white elk.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, Qingji garrison in Sizhou obtained a white elk.

sentences.zh: 十一年，廣陵海陵縣獲白麞一頭。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Hailing county in Guangling obtained a white elk.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Hailing county in Guangling obtained a white elk.

sentences.zh: 七年，越州獻白珠，自然作思惟佛像，長三寸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yuezhou presented a white pearl naturally formed as a seated Buddha in meditation, three cun long.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Yuezhou presented a white pearl shaped by nature into a seated Buddha in meditation, three cun long.

sentences.zh: 上起禪靈寺，置剎下。

translations.literal: The emperor built Chanling Temple and set it beneath the stupa.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor built Chanling Temple and enshrined it beneath a stupa.

sentences.zh: 七年，吳郡太守江斆於錢塘縣獲蒼玉璧一枚，以獻。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Jiang Mie, Administrator of Wu commandery, obtained a green jade bi at Qiantang county and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Jiang Mie, Administrator of Wu commandery, found a green jade bi at Qiantang county and presented it.

sentences.zh: 七年，主書朱靈讓於浙江得靈石，十人舉乃起，在水深三尺而浮，世祖親投于天淵池試之，刻爲佛像。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Zhu Lingrang of the Secretariat obtained a spirit stone at the Zhe River; ten men could barely lift it, yet in three chi of water it floated; Emperor Shizu personally cast it into the Tianyuan Pool to test it, then had it carved into a Buddhist image.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Zhu Lingrang of the Secretariat found a spirit stone in the Zhe River—ten men could scarcely raise it, yet in three chi of water it floated; Emperor Shizu himself cast it into the Tianyuan Pool to try it, then had it carved into a Buddha image.

sentences.zh: 二年，從陽丹水縣山下得古鼎一枚。

translations.literal: In the second year, below the mountain at Danshui county, Congyang, an ancient tripod was obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, below the mountain at Danshui in Congyang, men found an ancient tripod.

sentences.zh: 三年，越州南高凉俚人海中網魚，獲銅獸一頭，銘曰「作寶鼎，齊臣萬年子孫承寶」。

translations.literal: In the third year, Li barbarians of southern Gaoliang in Yuezhou netted fish in the sea and obtained a bronze beast; the inscription read, Making a precious tripod; Qi ministers' descendants for myriad ages shall inherit the treasure.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, Li people of southern Gaoliang in Yuezhou fished the sea and drew up a bronze beast inscribed, Making a precious tripod; Qi ministers' descendants for myriad ages shall inherit the treasure.

translations.literal: Appraisal
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal

sentences.zh: 贊曰：天降地出，星見先吉。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: What Heaven sends down and earth brings forth—when stars appear, good fortune comes first.
translations.idiomatic: In praise: Heaven sends them down, earth brings them forth; when stars appear, fortune comes first.

sentences.zh: 造物百品，詳之載述。

translations.literal: The myriad things the Creator makes are set forth here in full detail.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred creations of the Maker are told here in full.

translations.literal: [1] Endnote marker.
translations.idiomatic: [1] Endnote marker.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七二年一月版《南齊書》爲本校。

translations.literal: The full text has used as the base for collation the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Southern Qi, January 1972.
translations.idiomatic: The entire text has been collated against the Zhonghua Shuju edition of the Book of Southern Qi (January 1972).
